metadata.title: QQC-001: NanoDrop Nucleic Acid Quantification with Thermo Fisher NanoDrop One
metadata.purpose: Measure DNA or RNA concentration and A260/A280 and A260/A230 purity ratios by NanoDrop One pedestal measurement.
metadata.scope: Training/library SOP draft for a NanoDrop One microvolume UV-Vis spectrophotometer. Use NanoDrop as a purity screen and confirm against the current instrument manual, kit insert, SDS, and local laboratory policy before bench use.
beforeYouBegin: Use the blank solution that best matches the sample matrix, such as elution buffer or nuclease-free water.
Mix samples well and briefly spin down; avoid bubbles, particulates, and sample droplets on tube caps.
Clean the pedestal before blanking and between samples; residue causes carryover and abnormal ratios.
UV absorbance cannot distinguish target nucleic acid from free nucleotides, phenol, RNA/DNA mixture, or other absorbers.

materials.name: Matched blank solution
materials.specification: Use the same solution that best matches the sample matrix, such as elution buffer or nuclease-free water

materials.name: Qubit assay
materials.specification: Optional orthogonal concentration confirmation; more target-specific for low-concentration samples or library preparation

materials.name: Gel, Bioanalyzer, or TapeStation assay
materials.specification: Optional orthogonal concentration or integrity confirmation

equipment.name: Thermo Scientific NanoDrop One microvolume UV-Vis spectrophotometer
equipment.settings: Pedestal measurement for nucleic-acid concentration and purity ratios

tables.title: Run Record Template
rows: Blank, standard, ladder, or control details
tables.note: Blank run-record template provided in the source PDF.

steps.action: Open the appropriate nucleic-acid application on the NanoDrop One instrument.
Clean upper and lower pedestals with nuclease-free water and a lint-free wipe, then dry fully.
Load the matched blank solution onto the lower pedestal using the instrument-recommended volume.
Lower the arm and perform the blank measurement.
Wipe both pedestals clean and dry.
Mix the sample gently and load it onto the pedestal without introducing bubbles.

parameters.rawText: Common quick QC method requiring 1-2 uL sample

steps.action: Lower the arm and measure the sample.
Review concentration, A260/A280, A260/A230, and absorbance spectrum shape.

acceptanceCriteria.description: DNA A260/A280 is often near 1.8; interpret with extraction chemistry and sample type.
RNA A260/A280 is often near 2.0; interpret with extraction chemistry and sample type.
Low A260/A230 suggests salts, phenol, guanidinium, carbohydrates, ethanol, or other contaminants.

steps.expectedResult: Concentration, purity ratios, and spectrum shape are reviewed in sample context.

steps.action: Wipe pedestals between samples and repeat measurement for a technical replicate if accuracy is important.

repeat.notes: Perform a technical replicate if accuracy is important; the source gives no fixed replicate count.

steps.action: Export or record sample ID, application type, concentration, purity ratios, and any alert flags.
For low-concentration samples or library preparation, confirm concentration with Qubit; use an orthogonal integrity assay when indicated.

controls.name: Matched blank
controls.description: Use the same solution that best matches the sample matrix.

controls.name: Technical replicate
controls.description: Repeat measurement if accuracy is important; fixed replicate count is not specified.

expectedOutputs: Absorbance spectrum, alert flags, and completed measurement record.

troubleshooting.cause: Contaminants or mixed nucleic acid absorbing at 260 nm.
troubleshooting.solution: Use a Qubit-specific assay and inspect A230/A280/spectrum.

troubleshooting.cause: Dirty pedestal, bubbles, evaporation, or poor mixing.
troubleshooting.solution: Clean/reblank, mix sample, and reload carefully.

troubleshooting.cause: Salt, phenol, guanidinium, or ethanol carryover.
troubleshooting.solution: Repeat cleanup or precipitation and dry the sample appropriately.
Use a matched blank and clean the instrument.

safety: Wear a lab coat, gloves, and eye protection; handle nucleic acids and associated materials according to local EHS and biosafety rules.
Avoid contaminating shared instruments; clean pedestals and work surfaces according to instrument-compatible guidance.
Use nuclease-free consumables for RNA/DNA QC and RNase-free handling for RNA integrity checks.
